segments.name: Discovery and development
segments.description: Discovers and develops oral peptide medicines for inflammation and immunology, hematology and metabolic diseases, working with collaboration partners.
segments.evidence: The Company operates and manages its business as one operating segment, which primarily focuses on the discovery and development of innovative medicines in areas of unmet medical need.

revenueModel.text: Collaboration partners JNJ and Takeda pay upfront, milestone and cost-sharing payments rather than customers paying for products.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company derives revenues from its collaboration partners, consisting of non-refundable upfront and milestone payments
